context: These lines are Astarion’s default, out‑and‑about dialogue you trigger while he’s in your party; they fill out his backstory and react to things the player has done rather than advancing a specific quest. Early in the game many of his nodes are flagged so the player does not yet know he is a vampire; separate nodes cover his eventual reveal. Astarion’s tone is teasing, flirtatious, and provocative—here he ribs the PC about “the deed” (sex) after learning the PC slept with someone else, and the PC replies brusquely. Party makeup or later plot beats (for example meetings with Raphael or Orthon, or a hostile Laezel) can shift the tone of these casual exchanges.
